name: ZalithBoost FPS Engine (J706X 1.21.11)
description: Full rendering engine rewrite for Minecraft 1.21.11 on Zalith Launcher (J706X @ 65% resolution). Disables cave culling during Freecam while enforcing strict 6-plane screen-space frustum culling, sub-pixel culling, and Adreno 650 JNI GL state deduplication.
